raw_response:
I have farmed this land for 30 years. Never went to school, but I know cotton. Last year I planted improved seeds, the kind from the shop that everyone in the village uses. I put one big bag of 15-15-15 fertilizer on each mu before planting — that is 100 jin per mu. Then when the cotton was flowering, I added urea twice, about 30 jin each time. I irrigated four times from my well. The cotton bollworm was bad, so I sprayed 12 times total. I got about 600 jin of seed cotton per mu. This year I will do the same thing. I have 20 mu, which is a lot of land for two people, so I hire help for spraying and picking. I watch what my neighbors do. Old Wang and I always compare our fields, and when his cotton looks good, I do what he does. I would rather spend a bit more on fertilizer than risk a bad harvest. A bad year means losing real money. I will hire the rotary tiller from the village like every year.
